fields.title: Proteomics analysis of tissue aging nucleic acid binding proteins
fields.description: The landscape of NABPs in different mouse stage will assist in the greater understanding of the cellular and molecular mechanisms which control immune system development and aging.
fields.sample_protocol: NABPs were isolated by using Ti4+-IMAC Capture approach. Briefly, the prepared single cells were washed two times with PBS and cross-linked by formaldehyde (FA) at room temperature for 10 mins. After cross-linking, cells were lysed by 1 mL TRIZOL reagent and incubated at room temperature for 5 mins. 200 µL of chloroform was then added and vortexed at maximum speed for 15 s. The interphase and organic phase containing NAs-protein complexes were precipitated by isopropanol at room temperature for 10 mins. The precipitated NAs-protein complexes were further resuspended in 100 µL 0.1% SDS with proteinase cocktail and RNase inhibitor, then incubated at 55 °C for 20 mins and sonicated for 2 mins (250 w, working for 2 s and pausing for 10 s). The cross-links were then mixed with Ti4+-IMAC material, followed by vortex for 1 h. In order to remove nonspecific binding proteins, the pellet was washed with washing buffer (200 mM NaCl, 0.1% TFA, 0.1% NP-40, 10 mM EDTA) twice. The enriched NAs-protein complexes were eluted from Ti4+-IMAC with 10% ammonium hydroxide (NH3·H2O) by vortex and ultrasonication, then de-crosslinked by incubating at 65 °C for 6 h.Then proteins were digested by using Filter-aided sample preparation (FASP) approach. Proteins obtained from formaldehyde cross-linking and Organic solvent extraction optimized process was analyzed by Easy-nLC 1000 coupled with an LTQ Orbitrap XL mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA).  Proteins were analyzed by Easy-nanoLC1000 coupled with an Obitrap Q-Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA).
fields.keywords: Nucleic acid binding protemoics; Aging; Lc/ms-ms
